scope: User-authorized draft recovery and abandoned-action outcomes. Local-account-scoped drafts; no iPhone build, model-provider change, new sensor permission, analytics SDK or polling. This agent used only synthetic CI fixtures; root separately applied the immutable production migration.
supportedSurfaces: UnifiedPostComposer in PulseCreate: supported post_update, ask_question, share_moment, share_postcard, share_hidden_gem and share_food_spot types
excludedClaims: Dedicated HighlightComposer recovery is not implemented by this patch.
Native OS process termination, installed-device background transport and accessibility have not been verified.
This report does not close the 888-item master audit or assign an A++/100% grade.

completed.result: Account/composer local recovery, leave/restart, explicit discard, failed-submit preservation and exact-snapshot success clearing. Unknown/malformed storage is not replaced by an empty draft. Durable file/Blob copies and upload receipts survive supported restart paths.

New main-composer post, intent claim and post_media attachments commit in one service-only PostgreSQL RPC transaction. Attachment failure rolls everything back; response-loss retries reuse the completed operation. Postcard explicit publication remains private until committed. Canonical late writes and Passport projection inserts synchronize with cancellation through row locks.
evidence: 196 final API/SQL tests; read-only CI trigger/column/grant catalog review
Six actual CI PostgreSQL two-backend lock cases plus full-schema attachment failure rollback and response-loss replay; exact queries and results in docs/ops/rumazi-composer-ci-races-20261113.json

completed.result: Remote discard tombstones and original/thumbnail/feed deletion, existing pending-upload maintenance for late PUTs, canonical late-write guard, account deletion integration, and local durable deletion journal. Retry preserves saved-draft media. Each cleanup is idempotent; independent cleanup runs on launch/foreground/auth change without a new poller. Late Passport projection writes are refused while a postcard is draft/cancelled; cancellation removes any already-created projection.

Only enum-coded composer outcomes are exported; text/media/filenames/coordinates/content identifiers and raw errors are rejected. Existing MEDIA_ANALYTICS_ENABLED gate and original session own transport. No recommendation input is created. Client/API Sentry beforeSend and transaction hooks remove free-form payloads and SDK attachments while retaining code frames, error class and timing.
evidence: client and API crash payload tests

evidence: source review only for device accessibility

completed.result: Ready media creates no Passport projection before explicit publish; premature publish is refused; retry is idempotent; Taipei/Taiwan stays unverified and non-stamp-eligible with no stamps.

outcomes.deduplication: Client UUID retained through retries; server row ID hashes actor + event UUID. Payload stores no actor/content identifier.

storageAndPolicy.localDrafts: Feature data in AsyncStorage and app-owned native files or browser IndexedDB. Cleared only after acknowledged success or explicit discard; no new automatic expiry invented. No cloud draft sync added. A user-initiated postcard submission creates its existing operational shell privately.
storageAndPolicy.uploadIntents: Service-only operational rows, ownership checks, cancellation tombstones, erasure integrated into account deletion. Existing transport-expiry cutoff reused for late PUT cleanup.
storageAndPolicy.analytics: Existing service-only media_events table and MEDIA_ANALYTICS_ENABLED gate. This patch does not resolve the existing D6/Q11 retention governance backlog for all media_events. No new retention policy or flag activation performed.
storageAndPolicy.crashDiagnosticTradeoff: Free-form exception values, request data, breadcrumbs and span descriptions are removed. Code locations, standard error classes, trace IDs, timing and sourcemap debug IDs remain.

concurrencyReview.mainPost: commit_composer_post locks active profile FOR SHARE then owned intent FOR UPDATE, inserts post and all attachments in one transaction. claim_composer_upload requires the atomic-operation transaction marker. Compensating deletion is retained only for legacy no-operation clients.
concurrencyReview.cancelWinner: cancel_composer_upload locks the same intent. If cancellation wins, commit refuses and writes nothing; if commit wins, cancellation returns already_published and the UI shows publication, not discard. Unknown cleanup receipts preserve the local draft.
concurrencyReview.canonicalWrites: guard_composer_media_asset_write takes profile and intent FOR SHARE locks before accepting new canonical metadata; cancellation/erasure waits or the write sees the terminal state.
concurrencyReview.passportProjection: New Passport projection INSERT/UPDATE checks and locks its postcard parent. Cancel either deletes a committed projection or prevents a late copy from appearing after deletion. New post_media INSERT also locks/checks its parent.
concurrencyReview.compatibility: CI catalog read-only review confirmed enum types, required columns, no direct client writes to posts/post_media/media_assets, and existing moderation/invalidation triggers. passport_postcards previously had only set_updated_at trigger. Old clients omit deferPublication and publish on /complete; pre-existing null lifecycle rows retain legacy behavior. Root applied the exact migration to the full CI schema; real trigger interactions passed in the CI race/atomicity checks. Production migration activation was reported separately by root.

liveVerification.limitation: SQL ran as postgres with service/client grants checked separately. No real storage objects, authenticated end-to-end HTTP requests, native devices or hosted Sentry export were exercised in this database test.

performanceReview.nativeCopy: New persistence uses asynchronous native file copy; an already-owned file is reused without another copy. Draft records hold paths/form data, not media bytes. Retained originals survive cancelled uploads; separate prepared copies are cleaned.
performanceReview.limits: Existing client envelope is 10 MB images/50 MB video; missing picker size still requires server validation. Native OS quota, interruption during copy, and large-device-memory behavior remain device checks.
performanceReview.hostEvidence: 50 MB filesystem adapter proof verifies exact bytes, removed-source recovery, one-copy reuse and idempotent delete. It uses Node filesystem effects, not Expo; browser IndexedDB proof is separate.
performanceReview.resources: Synthetic 50 MB source and copy removed after test; no PostgreSQL test server started; failed initdb scratch directories removed. No unknown IPC or user process was altered. Subsequent CI checks created only synthetic metadata; no storage bytes. All fixture records and one-shot jobs/history/sessions were removed and zero counts independently verified.
